mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are a pleasant 73 degrees with clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. Tonight, the First Quarter moon will be out, and if you look up at 10:22 PM, you can spot the ISS as it travels from over Cross Plains toward Oregon near the Costco, reaching halfway up the sky. It will be a cool night with a low of 56 degrees and no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona keeps everyone informed through the VHAT cable channel and the official city blog. You can find meeting schedules, resources, and sign up for the monthly digital newsletter to stay connected with community projects and council summaries.

Today is packed with activities, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead to tomorrow, make sure to check out the Concerts in the Park series or join the fun at Hop Haus Trivia.
In our weekly police recap, we noted that on Sunday, July 13th, officers arrested a driver for an O-W-I after they were found trying to dislodge a vehicle that had become stuck on a large rock.
Today's flavor is Mint Explosion, and you can pick some up at Culver's before they close at 10 PM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor will be Really Reese's.
